name: EmailAttachments
description: Email attachments and their extracted content
technicalDescription: One row per attachment of an InboundEmails row. FetchEmailAttachments downloads each file from the provider (GMAIL_GET_ATTACHMENT), stores it (fileUrl) and extracts text by code: PDF with a text layer → text, Excel/CSV → table as text, image or scanned PDF → דורש OCR (gap). Maya and the remittance reader receive extractedText, not just file names.

columns.name: messageId
columns.description: Provider message id of the email

columns.name: extractedText
columns.description: Extracted text (long text; tables as tab-separated lines)

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for marked test data; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).
